utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Oren — I’m glad it’s a gentle one. I’ll bring the copy on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh lovely, thank you, Uli — Thursday works for me. I’ll try to remember my glasses so I can keep up with everyone!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thank you. I’m looking forward to it—hopefully it’ll be a calm evening for all of us.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Rosa — do we have a book picked yet, and is book club still on for tonight?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — we haven’t picked the book yet, and it’s not on tonight. The book club has been moved to Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll share the picks as soon as we have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Thursday at the cafe works. Please send the book picks when they’re ready, and I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d keep it easy and lively—good mysteries, funny fiction, maybe a short nonfiction pick now and then. Busy folks’ll be more likely to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect — I’m in for keeping it light and flexible. I’ll plan around school pickup and text you if I’m running late.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just text me if you’re running late, and we’ll keep it flexible.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — just let me know what the plan is, and I can bring chairs or help set up for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. If you can bring chairs and help set up, I’ll keep track of the snacks and wait on the headcount.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Cleo — I’ll bring the chairs and help with setup. Just send me the headcount when you have it, and we’ll make sure the room’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month, and I can bring the meeting time and discussion questions if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Eli — thanks. Send the meeting time and questions when you can, and I’ll help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll send the meeting time and discussion questions shortly so we can keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still checking on the headcount—once I hear back, I’ll let everyone know if tonight’s book club is definitely on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Once you know the headcount, let me know so I can make sure everyone has time to get copies sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the count, and then we’ll know if book club is on for tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details tonight and spread the word to a few good fits for the book club. Thanks for keeping Wednesday evening open!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll watch for the address and time tonight, and I’ll keep Wednesday evening on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll text you the address and time tonight, and I’ll make sure a few book-club friends hear about it too. If anyone else comes to mind, just send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s been pretty cozy—just a small group chatting, though I still keep forgetting which book we’re on. I’ll dig up the details and message you soon so we can keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — that sounds good. I’m still checking the book club details too, so once you find the book, send it my way and I’ll confirm everything before we share it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll look it up and send you the book details soon, so we can make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, great — is it still *The Midnight Library*? If so, I’ll try to grab a copy before the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds right to me — *The Midnight Library* it is. I can help with snacks and chairs if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. I’ll bring a copy and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll repeat the plan at book club so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll bring a couple lively mystery options and see which one gets the best reaction.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll make sure everyone hears the options clearly at book club.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on the next book, too, and make sure the Thursday plan is clear. If I hear back on the pick, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks for keeping it moving. Let me know the book pick when you hear back, and I’m happy to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’m heading by now and will check the book pick and the Thursday details. I’ll circle back as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mina — I’m still waiting on the final time and book pick from the others. I’ll text you as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — thanks, Nell. Just text me when the time and book are finalized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll send you the final time and book as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice — a small, cozy book club is the best kind. If you want, I can help figure out which book you’re on and suggest a light next read.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether the book club is actually on tonight, and which book we’re reading? I’d rather not head over if it’s still undecided.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure yet, but I can check and let you know right away. If it is tonight, we’ll keep it cozy and low-key.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Nice — do we know the meeting date yet, and is everyone able to get a copy of *The Midnight Library*?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at the cafe is set, but I’m still waiting on the final picks. Once they’re shared, I’ll pass them along so everyone can get a copy in time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — just let me know when the final picks are out, and I’ll make sure I can grab a copy in time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great — what book is the club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’d keep it simple: maybe a good mystery or a funny novel — something lively and easy to get through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a good direction—do you want me to narrow it down to one mystery or one funny novel for us to vote on?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, we’re still on for tonight, and we’re reading *The Midnight Library*. I’m just waiting on the exact time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—thanks, Nell. Just send the exact time when you have it, and I’ll keep the snacks and pens ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s confirmed. Thanks for being ready with snacks and pens!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the book club right away. Want me to invite anyone in particular?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Quinn — I’m a bit fuzzy, but maybe Mina and Sam? Whoever’s easiest to loop in is fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll invite Mina and Sam and send them the book club details tonight. If anyone else comes to mind, just let me know!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on the final book club title and location, Faye, but I’ll keep track and share the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. I’m still good for 7 after pickup, and I’ll text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got 7 after pickup noted, and I’ll keep watching for the final title and location.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah — I’m still leaning toward a light, cozy read. If you’ve got a few good picks, send them my way and I’ll help narrow it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds perfect — I’m leaning cozy too, though I keep mixing up what we already read. I’ll send you a few picks and we can narrow it down together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — send them over, and I’ll help pick the one that’ll make the best discussion.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. Thursday works, and I’ll bring the short novel to keep things gentle.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll repeat that Thursday works and that you’re bringing the short novel so everyone’s on the same page at book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That helps a lot — simple and clear is exactly what I need right now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Ira — happy to help with the book club if you need anything. I can bring folding tables or extra chairs, and I’m always up for good debate and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a huge help. I’m checking on the next book pick and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know the pick when you hear back, and I’ll have the tables and chairs ready. I’m looking forward to the discussion and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send over a few lively options soon so we can pick one. 7 pm still works, but we can shift a bit if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds great, Leo — send the options when you can, and we’ll choose one together. 7 still works for me, and we can shift a bit if that helps everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send a few options over soon, and we can pick the one that feels most fun to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month. I can bring the meeting time and the discussion questions if you want.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’d love that. Send the meeting time and discussion questions, and I’ll make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll send the meeting time and discussion questions over, and I’ll keep it clear for everyone at book club.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina — the book club is set for Thursday at the cafe now. I’ll send the book picks as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — Thursday at the cafe works. Just send the book pick when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll share the book pick as soon as it’s set, so everyone can plan ahead.
